label: STP
notes: Spanning Tree Protocol BPDUs (IEEE 802.1D-2004) over 802.2 LLC on Ethernet: DSAP/SSAP 0x42, UI control 0x03, sent to 01:80:c2:00:00:00. The anchor base is 17 (14-byte Ethernet + 3-byte LLC header) and the locator matches the LLC header bytes. headerLength 35 is the Configuration/RST BPDU of Fig. 9-1/9-3; a TCN BPDU carries only the first 4 bytes, which the early fields still cover. Cisco PVST+/rapid-PVST (SNAP-encapsulated on the Cisco multicast address) is out of scope. The Root and Bridge Identifier MAC halves are modelled as mac fields (4+2 two-load conjunctions). Not modelled: the 2-bit RSTP Port Role sub-field of the flags byte (a two-bit enum is not expressible as single-bit bitset masks; 0 unknown, 1 alternate/backup, 2 root, 3 designated). The four timers are stored on the wire in 1/256-second units, so filter values are wire units (20 s Max Age = 5120). Their fixtures use 0/1 because scapy's timer kwargs are seconds (wire = 256 x kwarg) and the fixture value must be both the built kwarg and the matched wire value; golden vectors carry realistic wire values.

fields.label: Protocol Version Identifier
fields.description: 0 for classic STP (802.1D), 2 for RSTP (802.1D-2004 clause 17), 3 for MSTP (802.1Q clause 13).

fields.label: BPDU Type
fields.description: 0x00 Configuration, 0x02 RST/MST, 0x80 Topology Change Notification (TCN BPDUs stop after this byte).

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Classic STP defines TC (bit 0) and TCA (bit 7); Proposal/Learning/Forwarding/Agreement are the RSTP additions of Fig. 9-3.

fields.label: Root Bridge ID Priority
fields.description: The most significant 2 octets of the 8-byte Root Bridge Identifier; the trailing 6 bytes are the root bridge MAC address (not modelled). Configured priorities are multiples of 4096 (default 32768).

fields.label: Root Mac
fields.description: The 48-bit address half of the 8-byte Root Bridge Identifier.

fields.label: Root Path Cost
fields.description: Path cost from the transmitting bridge to the root; 0 on the root bridge itself.

fields.label: Bridge ID Priority
fields.description: The most significant 2 octets of the 8-byte Bridge Identifier; the trailing 6 bytes are the transmitting bridge's MAC address (not modelled).

fields.label: Bridge Mac
fields.description: The 48-bit address half of the 8-byte Bridge Identifier.

fields.label: Port Identifier
fields.description: Port priority (4 bits) plus port number (12 bits) of the transmitting port, e.g. 0x8001 for port priority 128, port 1.

fields.label: Message Age
fields.description: Time since the root bridge originated the configuration information, in 1/256-second units (1 s = 256, 0 on the root bridge).

fields.label: Max Age
fields.description: Maximum age of configuration information, in 1/256-second units (20 s = 5120).

fields.label: Hello Time
fields.description: Interval between configuration BPDUs, in 1/256-second units (2 s = 512).

fields.label: Forward Delay
fields.description: Listening/learning state duration, in 1/256-second units (15 s = 3840).
